topic: The Great Wall of China was built and rebuilt over many centuries by different dynasties; most of the wall people visit today was built in the Ming period.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: The Great Wall’s Big Story

shots.narration: Golden sparkles! Where has Zoya’s watch brought them?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit Great Wall of China during the Ming period, broad stone walkway between tall parapets, green mountain ridges, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize together inside a swirl of golden sparkles and dust.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue watch glow against warm golden sunlight.

shots.narration: They’ve reached the Great Wall of China!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, broad Great Wall walkway with protective parapets and distant mountain watchtowers, bright cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the winding wall.
shots.mood: Wide green mountain views beneath a clear blue sky.

shots.narration: [surprised] This wall wasn’t built all at once!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Great Wall walkway beside textured masonry, distant wall following mountain ridges, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya traces the distant wall’s winding shape with her finger.
shots.mood: Sunlit stone textures and an astonished open-mouthed smile.

shots.narration: It was built and rebuilt over many centuries.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of Great Wall masonry along a sheltered walkway, warm sunlight, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya gently rests her palm against the stone wall.
shots.mood: Soft golden light reveals rough stone surfaces.

shots.narration: Different dynasties helped build and rebuild it.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Great Wall walkway leading toward a masonry watchtower, mountain landscape beyond tall parapets, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Tock gestures along the wall with his spring tail.
shots.mood: Warm brass highlights against sunlit gray masonry.

shots.narration: [excited] Most wall people visit today was built during the Ming period!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sweeping view along the Great Wall during the Ming period, sturdy parapets and watchtower, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya points toward the nearby watchtower.
shots.mood: Bright sunlight and sparkling blue reflections from Zoya’s watch.

shots.narration: But Tock has a tiny problem.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, base of a stone stair on the Great Wall, enclosed by tall protective masonry, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Tock raises a tiny leg toward the tall step.
shots.mood: A towering stone step above a small puzzled brass face.

shots.narration: That step is enormous for his little legs!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sheltered Great Wall stair landing, Zoya beside Tock at the bottom step, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Tock stretches his leg without reaching the step’s top.
shots.mood: Comically stretched posture in gentle afternoon sunlight.

shots.narration: [giggles] Luckily, Zoya has a helping hand.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, broad stone landing beside the Great Wall stairs, tall parapets, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya offers her open palm beside Tock.
shots.mood: A reassuring smile and warm light on an outstretched hand.

shots.narration: Together, even a big step feels smaller.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, enclosed Great Wall stair landing, Zoya holding Tock securely in her palm, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya lifts Tock onto the upper landing.
shots.mood: Tock’s spring tail curls upward in a cheerful arc.

shots.narration: Centuries of building, and a little teamwork to explore!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, spacious Great Wall landing behind tall parapets, winding wall visible across green mountains, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Zoya raises her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Fresh golden sparkles gather around the blue watch glow.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Great Wall landing surrounded by rising golden time-travel sparkles, green mountains beyond protective parapets, cinematic 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Tock turns his round glass face toward Zoya to ask his question.
shots.mood: Bright expectant eyes reflected in glass amid swirling gold.

episode.endHook: Zoya’s watch glows again—another adventure is waiting!
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle onto the Great Wall of China during the Ming period. Discover how different dynasties built and rebuilt the wall over centuries—and why a little teamwork helps on a big adventure!
